research_notes: LEVEL BASIS: every level is the latest audited (restated where applicable) consolidated figure. FY2024 and the FY2023 balance sheet come from the FY2025 audited FS, restated for PSAK 117 (insurance contracts). The effect is small: 2024 total assets 1,992,186,906 vs 1,992,983,447 originally; 2024 PATMI 59,944,649 vs 60,154,887; EPS 398 vs 399 (Rp mn). The 2023 P&L was not restated.

PSAK 38 (FY2020): the FY2020 balance sheet is restated to include Pegadaian and PNM (common-control acquisition, 13 Sep 2021), per the FY2021 audited FS and every later multi-year table. FY2019 was never restated. As a result, 2020-vs-2019 growth is NOT like-for-like. Originally reported 2020 figures: total assets 1,511,804,628; total equity 199,911,376; equity attributable 197,377,567 (Rp mn). Restated 2020 equity attributable includes Rp29,538,484mn of pro forma acquiree capital, but 2020 profit (18,654,753, unchanged) excludes their income. Any ROE computed for 2020 (and the 2021 average) is therefore understated. 2021 profit includes Pegadaian/PNM only from 13 Sep 2021.

loans_gross = Loans + Sharia loans/receivables + Finance (lease) receivables, gross of allowance. This is the AR line 'Loans, Sharia Receivables, and Financing' and the deck's 'Total Loan & Financing'; it was checked against the FS lines for each year. deposits = customer deposits, plus temporary syirkah (mudharabah) funds in 2019-2020, when BRISyariah was consolidated; BRIS merged into BSI on 1 Feb 2021.

shares_out = issued shares (151,559,001,604 since the Sep-2021 rights issue; 123,345,810,000 before) minus the treasury shares printed in each FS Note 1d. The subtraction was done here, as instructed, because no net figure is printed. 2021 treasury: FY2021 FS says 15,931,600; FY2022-25 FS say 15,931,900 (used).

SELF-CHECK eps x shares_out vs net_profit_attr: within 0.25% for 2020, 2022-2025. 2021 is +16.1% (238 x 151.54bn = 36.07tn vs 31.07tn) because the rights issue added 28.2bn shares in Sep-2021; FY2021 basic EPS uses 130,552,591,419 weighted shares. This is expected; no data changed.

SELF-CHECK dividends: sum of dps x shares_out matches the sum of dividend totals within 0.2% for every FY 2020-2025. net_profit_attr x payout_ratio matches the totals within 0.1%, except FY2024 (-0.34%): the 86% payout was set on the original 2024 PATMI (60,154.89bn) and we store the PSAK-117 restated 59,944.65bn.

DIVIDENDS: DPS are raw figures as announced in the IDX e-reporting forms. The IR dividend page (ir-bri.com/dividend.html) and the AR2025 dividend history adjust pre-Sep-2021 DPS by a rights factor (FY2020 final: 96.49 vs 98.90566 announced) - not used for dps. BRI paid no interim for FY2020 or FY2021; interims resumed with FY2022 (paid Jan-2023; the previous ones were FY2009/FY2010). FY2026 interim: none announced as of 2026-11-02 (regulatory-filings list on ir-bri.com shows no interim-dividend item in 2026; prior interims were announced 16-30 Dec). Totals for interim and FY2024-final payments are the amounts actually paid (AR2025 p.489), because the IDX forms give only min/max ranges.

INTERIM: 9M2026 is not yet published. ir-bri.com financial reports, presentations and regulatory filings (checked 2026-11-02) end at Q2-2026; the only Q3 item is 'Notification to Engage a Limited Review of the Q3-2026 Quarterly Financial Statement' (23 Sep 2026), and the expected Q3-2026 URLs return 404. bri.co.id serves an Incapsula bot challenge and idx.co.id a Cloudflare 403; neither was bypassed. H1-2026 (audited interim FS) is used instead. Its *_prior values are 30 Jun 2025 figures from the 1H26 deck (the FS compares the balance sheet with 31 Dec 2025).

RATIO SOURCES: nim, roa, roe (FY2025 deck p.14) and coc (p.33), npl_gross, npl_coverage and lar (p.32) come from the single restated consolidated series in the FY2025 analyst deck, so 2020-2025 share one methodology. The new NIM method (Jan-2025) is applied retroactively, and consolidated ratios are monthly-based from 2024. NIM/ROA/ROE are printed to 1 decimal. As originally reported in each year's deck, consolidated values differ: NIM 2020R 6.90, 2021 7.70, 2022 7.85, 2023 7.95, 2024 7.74; ROE B/S 2020R 10.52, 2021 13.86, 2022 17.63, 2023 19.95, 2024 19.01; ROA AT 2020R 1.46, 2021 2.13, 2022 3.01, 2023 3.24, 2024 3.06; CoC 2021 3.78, 2023 2.38.

LAR 2020 is bank-only (28.26%); the decks say LAR is consolidated only from 2021. The FY2025 deck contradicts itself on 2020 LAR: 25.8% 'Consolidated Number' on p.14 vs 28.3% on p.7. The 1H2026 deck (p.31) silently shows different 2021-2022 history: NPL 3.09/3.30, NPL coverage 272.20/247.70, LAR 23.09/18.06. Those differ from the FY2021-FY2025 decks, which print 3.00/2.67, 281.16/305.73, 23.31/16.54 (kept). No explanation was found.

CIR, CAR and CASA are consolidated, as originally reported in each FY deck (2020 = PSAK-38 restated column in the FY2021 deck). CIR has a definition break between 2022 and 2023: the FY2023 deck restated 2022 from 47.38% to 44.87%. The FY2025 deck p.25 chart shows the old-definition series 50.9/48.6/47.4/41.9/41.4/42.5, with 2024 at 41.4% vs 41.59% in the FY2024 deck. CIR is not BOPO and not CER (cost efficiency ratio, e.g. 2021 consolidated CER 50.25%).

ldr, npl_net and bopo are BANK-ONLY OJK ratios (AR2025 p.31 for 2021-2025; AR2024 p.27-28 for 2020). The company's consolidated LDR changed definition: the FY2021 deck includes all subsidiaries (2021: 91.58%), while from the FY2022 deck it covers bank entities only (2021: 83.53%). Note that AR ratio tables mix bases: AR2024's 'bank only' CASA row is consolidated for 2021-2024, and AR2023 labels bank-only CIR as 'consolidated'. They were not used for those fields.

AR TYPOS found and avoided (audited FS used instead): AR2023 p.30 shows 2022 PATMI as 48,333,349 (that is comprehensive income); AR2021 p.33 and AR2024 p.23 show 2020 total equity as 229,446,882 (FS: 229,466,882); AR2025 p.488 dates the 2024-final cash-market cum and record dates as 2024 instead of 2025.

CORPORATE ACTIONS: no stock split or reverse split in 2020-2026 (AR2025 p.200 share chronology lists the last split on 10 Nov 2017; AR2025 p.36 states no share-count corporate actions in 2025; issued shares are unchanged at 151,559,001,604 at 30 Jun 2026, and the 2026 filings list shows no split). The only issuance was the Sep-2021 rights issue. Share buybacks in 2020 and 2022-2026 only move treasury shares. The rights record carries an extra key 'exercise_price' (Rp3,400) because the task requires it.

YEAR-END PRICES are the Q4 closing prices from the AR share tables. as_of_date/share_basis are set to Dec-31 because the ARs do not print the exact last trading day. The 2020 price comes from AR2020, which predates the rights issue and so is unadjusted; AR2021/AR2022 rights-adjusted only Q1-Q3 2021 prices.
KBMI 4 rests on company award listings (no regulatory statement found in the AR or FS), plus core capital far above the Rp70tn threshold. Treat it as well-supported but indirect.

validation_ack.reason: Rights issue (HMETD I) added 28.21bn shares in Sep 2021, so FY2021 basic EPS (Rp238) uses weighted-average shares of 130,552,591,419 (audited FS 2021, EPS note) while shares_out is the year-end 151.54bn. Profit 31,066,592 ÷ 130.55bn = 238 — the gap is real, not a data error.
